intent: Set a bounded quantity through one large precise number and a ruler that explains its position within the allowed range.

layout.direction: A 448px maximum-width quantity panel with a compact heading, 60px precise value, 44px canonical step buttons and a 33-tick ruler. Values longer than five characters occupy a complete line above the controls; fit their font between 16px and 60px using the container width and character count.
layout.container: Size to the parent with @container. Keep the root width at 100%, capped to the focused component, with 24px desktop and 16px narrow padding.

typography.heading: 18px medium, tracking -0.025em
typography.value: 60px display, tabular numerals, tracking -0.06em; long values use clamp(16px, container width / characters * 1.45, 60px)

motion.entrance: A single opacity and 8px rise over 320ms.
motion.interaction: Canonical button press and focus states, 400ms hold delay then 60ms repeats, and a 240ms ruler slide. Precise entry updates immediately.
motion.reduced: Remove transforms and layout motion, including active fills or ruler transitions when the preference changes; keep opacity at 120ms or less.

responsive.rules: Wrap long copy; stack secondary details inside narrow containers; keep any horizontal scrolling local and keyboard accessible.

accessibility: Use native buttons and form controls with visible 2px focus rings.
Provide labels, meaningful states and polite feedback where actions update content.
Keep IDs instance-scoped with useId; support multiple instances and empty custom data.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion; no automatic action or navigation.

content.defaults: Use the realistic default content from the source; expose content and collection inputs as typed props.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value; host must update it in onChange. Without onChange, editing is read-only.

props.name: min
props.description: Lower bound; invalid values become zero.

props.name: max
props.description: Upper bound, normalized to at least min.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Emits each changed finite bounded number, preserving safe integer digits; normalized no-ops emit nothing.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink palette; the demo stage follows the chosen theme.

avoid: Remote images, fake network success or hidden external dependencies.
Decorative status badges, gradients as filler, low-contrast text.
Unlabelled controls, hover-only functionality, overflow at 320px.
contract: Clamp finite edits to normalized bounds; invalid drafts revert, Escape cancels and IME Enter never commits.

Preserve complete typed values, exact bounds and safe integer digits. Normalize only stepping noise to the precision of its actual operands. Compute a finite ruler position even when subtracting finite endpoints overflows.
Support arrows, Home/End and Shift-arrow ten-step changes. Canonical buttons repeat after 400ms and every 60ms while held, stopping on outside release, cancellation, blur, disabling or unmount.
Controlled values wait for host acknowledgement. A missing writer is read-only; disabled prevents all edits. Suppress callbacks for a normalized no-op.
Keep the canonical control-kit button states around the component-specific large figure and ruler. Live reduced motion settles the ruler immediately.
